name: Divine Realm
description: The highest realm of power, the font of all others and dwelling of God, angels and saints; also known as the True Empyrean.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm of power whose sovereigns are associated with Pride; Hermetic researchers believe it is intimately connected to the Divine.

name: Faerie Realm
description: Realm of Arcadia and the fay, a dim reflection of Heaven's light, which shies from divine manifestations.

name: Infernal Realm
description: Realm of the Devil and Hell, the Divine's most implacable foe; kabbalists see it as a decline from the Light called sitra ahra.

name: Dominion
description: The most common Divine aura, God's Kingdom on Earth, manifesting around communities of faithful worshippers and radiating from churches, mosques and synagogues.

name: Divine Aura
description: Emanation of the Divine realm onto the earth, manifesting as the Dominion or Empyreal auras; varies in strength, waning at night and waxing on holy days.

name: Empyreal Aura
description: A Divine aura untouched by worldly matters, radiating from relics, saints, miracle sites or divine creatures rather than a congregation; manifests as a sphere.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural field rated 1 to 10 associated with a realm; Divine auras trump other realms' auras of equal strength.

name: Dominion Rite
description: Ritual by a celebrant with an appropriate Social Virtue before a congregation of ten, used to consecrate an area and allow the Dominion to enter it.

name: Consecration
description: Blessing of a site or altar, often by interring relics beneath it, required before a Dominion can be created.

name: Regio
description: Pocket realm discrete from the surrounding aura, entered in levels; Divine regiones are either terrestrial or celestial.

name: Divine Regio
description: Sub-lunar paradise typifying a holy virtue, created by saints' prayers, divine beings or Divine Will, always located in a Divine aura.

name: Terrestrial Regio
description: Divine regio tied to a geographic place, a holy version of the world typifying a virtue of the flesh such as courage or honor.

name: Celestial Regio
description: Spiritual Divine regio not bound to earth, home of angels and divine powers, generally entered only by invitation.

name: Celestial Disorientation
description: Overwhelming effect on mortals entering a celestial regio, resisted with Stamina + Dominion Lore against regio rating x3.

name: Spontaneous Regio
description: Temporary Divine regio created by a divine effect of tenth magnitude or greater.

name: Divine Might
description: The Might score of divine beings; beings with 20 or more can spend it to create temporary Divine regiones.

name: Faith Points
description: Measure of True Faith; people and relics with five or more radiate an Empyreal aura, and they can be spent to ignore celestial disorientation.

name: True Faith
description: Holy power possessed by the devout; characters with it may endure celestial regiones for days rather than hours.

name: Holy Magic
description: Secret by which Hermetic magi reconcile their power with the Dominion.

name: Holy Influence
description: Rules for how Divine auras inspire Personality Traits and tempers in those within them.

name: Temper
description: A Personality Trait infused into a Divine aura, e.g. a Just Temper, created by Tempering or angelic powers.

name: Divine Warping
description: Warping from Divine sources, which may cause Divine Ascent.

name: Divine Ascent
description: Process triggered by gaining two or more Warping Points from Divine sources, during which no further Warping is gained.

name: Warping
description: Supernatural accumulation of Warping Points; gained from prolonged exposure to celestial regiones or botched Dominion rites.

name: Miracle
description: Divine act through which God's will is worked; powerful miracles generate Empyreal auras and may create regiones.

name: Relic
description: Holy remains of saints; relics with more than five Faith Points raise the Dominion, and are interred under altars in consecration.

name: Eucharist
description: The consecrated Host and wine, transubstantiated into Christ's body and blood; radiates a Dominion of five until the next Good Friday.

name: Transubstantiation
description: Miraculous replacement of the substance of wafer and wine with that of Christ at the words of consecration.

name: Mass
description: Christian ritual performed as the Dominion rite in Christianity and the Sacrifice in which the Eucharist is consecrated.

name: Baptism
description: Christian sacrament, referenced as the equivalent of the Domination power Liberate the Sinful.

name: Sacraments
description: Church rites, including exorcism and invoking saints, covered in the Mythic Christianity chapter.

name: The Gift
description: The magical talent of magi, whose might feels reduced to a dim spark under the gaze of the Divine.

name: Twilight
description: Magical experience of magi, compared to the reverent introspection a Divine aura may evoke.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Supernatural protection which angelic illumination speech must penetrate.

name: Penetration
description: Ability to overcome magic resistance; True Names grant a +5 bonus to a caster's Penetration multiplier.

name: True Name
description: An angel's or being's secret mystic name granting occult power over it, acting as an indefinite Arcane Connection.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Mystical link to a target; True Names act as indefinite Arcane Connections.

name: Illumination
description: Angelic mode of communication conveying the essence of a message directly to the soul, with Penetration zero.

name: Limit of the Divine
description: Hermetic limit commonly believed to give angels significant protection from Hermetic magic.

name: Hermetic Theory
description: Body of Hermetic thought, one foundation of which is that the Divine is the highest of realms.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power found in pawns; objects in powerful Divine regiones and divine creatures may contain vis.

name: Personality Traits
description: Character traits such as Pious or Joyful; angels share fixed traits and are immune to magic contrary to them.

name: Love of God
description: Personality Trait possessed at +5 by all angels.

name: Guardian Angel
description: Angel protecting an individual, who may take a character to a celestial regio in a vision or dream.

name: Angelic Mantle
description: Angelic power (2 points, Corpus) to manifest in apparently mortal flesh, subject to natural law while in it.

name: Enfolding
description: Angelic power (Vim) rendering the soul, or at greater cost the body, of the pious wholly protected for a brief moment.

name: Envisioning
description: Angelic power (Mentem) to appear in dreams or waking visions and impart a Divine message.

name: Heavenly Fire
description: Seraphim power, as Pilum of Fire but doing +30 damage.

name: Smite Evil
description: Seraphim power, as Demon's Eternal Oblivion, which also affects faeries.

name: Divine Insight
description: Cherubim power granting Clear Thinker, Free Expression or Inspirational until the target sins.

name: The Chariot
description: Cherubim power used by four cherubim to bow the heavens and purify a target, removing Warping, Decrepitude and Aging Points.

name: Deliverance of the Righteous
description: Thrones power instantly transporting endangered worshippers to safety.

name: Divine Justice
description: Thrones power to learn the truth and most just judgment of a case.

name: Radiant Mirror
description: Thrones power reflecting Primal Divine Light to raise a Divine aura by two with a Just Temper.

name: Divine Direction
description: Domination power to command beings of equal or lesser Divine Might or those aligned to the Divine.

name: Liberate the Sinful
description: Domination power permanently removing a sinful Personality Trait.

name: Divine Authority
description: Authority power giving absolute knowledge and command over one aspect of creation.

name: Divine Balance
description: Potentate power creating a virtuous thought to oppose a devil's sinful suggestion.

name: Mysterious Path
description: Potentate power creating an instantly traversable path between two locations.

name: Incalculable Strength of Heaven
description: Principality power banishing non-Divine creatures from its domain for a day.

name: Sway the Hearts of Man
description: Principality power inculcating a temper in many minds under a Divine aura.

name: Irresistible Light
description: Archangel power radiating Divine Light doing +40 damage to non-Divine beings and stripping Might.

name: Infinite Divisibility
description: Archangel power to split into many self-aware copies to attend to all duties at once.

name: Four Worlds
description: Kabbalistic scheme of four stages of emanation from the Divine: Atzilut, Beriyah, Yetzirah, Asiyah.

name: Atzilut
description: Highest of the Four Worlds (Emanation), the eternal Divine realm.

name: Beriyah
description: Second of the Four Worlds (Creation), associated by Hermetic magi with the Magic realm.

name: Yetzirah
description: Third of the Four Worlds (Formation), considered Arcadia or the Invisible World of angels and spirits.

name: Asiyah
description: Lowest of the Four Worlds (Action), the mundane material universe.

name: Qlippot
description: Husks or shells of earlier creations from which the Infernal's rival Tree grows.

name: Sefirot
description: Kabbalistic emanations; the Ofanim are associated with the sefira Chokmah (Wisdom).

name: Seven Heavens
description: Seven celestial mansions into which Heaven is stratified, ruled by Archangels.

name: Heaven
description: Dwelling of God, angels and saints within the Divine realm, locked in conflict with Hell.

name: Throne of God
description: God's Throne in Araboth, which Hell seeks to overthrow.

name: Shamayim
description: The First Heaven, abode of the stars, ruled by Gabriel.

name: Raqia
description: The Second Heaven, imprisoning evil angels, ruled by Raphael, Galizur and Zachariel.

name: Shehaqin
description: The Third Heaven, where the Garden of Eden and Tree of Life reside.

name: Machonon
description: The Fourth Heaven, containing the City of Christ and heavenly Jerusalem, ruled by Michael.

name: Mathey
description: The Fifth Heaven, true Empyrean and home of the Avenging Angels, dwelling of Metatron ruled by Shatqiel.

name: Zebul
description: The Sixth Heaven of icy storms, home of Cherubim and Phoenixes, ruled by Zachiel and Sabath.

name: Araboth
description: The Seventh Heaven, location of God's Throne, ruled by Cassiel.

name: Garden of Eden
description: Paradise now residing in the Third Heaven; source of the tree guarded by Michael.

name: Tree of Life
description: Tree growing in the Third Heaven, from which came the manna of Israel.

name: Tree of Knowledge
description: Tree from which Adam ate, giving rise to the qlippot.

name: City of Christ
description: Heavenly city in the Fourth Heaven, also beyond Lake Acherusia.

name: Heavenly Jerusalem
description: Heavenly city in the Fourth Heaven ruled by Michael.

name: Tree Guarded by Michael
description: Sample Empyreal aura: a sacred tree from Eden (Divine Might 50) on a mountain, likely in the Caucasus, radiating aura 5; its seedlings' fruit grants Joyful and slows aging.

name: Lake Acherusia
description: Sample terrestrial regio from the Apocalypse of Paul near Tarsus, a multilevel regio leading to a city where Michael baptizes the repentant.

name: Treasury of the Four Winds
description: Sample celestial regio (level 7) storing all winds, guarded by servants of Metatron, Kemuel, Nathanael and Gabriel.

name: Athlit
description: The Pilgrim's Castle, Templar fortress between Haifa and Acre with elevated Dominion ratings; formerly Destroit.

name: Acre
description: City near Athlit, noted for sin.

name: Haifa
description: Coastal town near Athlit.

name: Caesarea
description: Diocese in which Athlit is situated.

name: Jerusalem
description: Holy city, site of the Wailing Wall, Church of the Holy Sepulcher and Dome of the Rock.

name: Rome
description: Seat of St. Peter's Basilica and the Lateran Basilica.

name: Mecca
description: City of the grand mosque, a seat of the Dominion's power.

name: Constantinople
description: City of the Church of Holy Wisdom.

name: Barcelona
description: City where the Order tried to force kabbalist rabbis to join or die.

name: Tarsus
description: Home of Paul, near the Lake Acherusia regio.

name: Iberia
description: Region whose magi deal with Jewish sorcerers.

name: Provence
description: Region whose magi deal with Jewish sorcerers.

name: Caucasus Mountains
description: Likely location of the Tree Guarded by Michael.

name: Mount Sinai
description: Holy site with high Dominion (5-10) and terrestrial regiones.

name: Noah's Ark
description: Holy site whose resting place hosts terrestrial regiones; two Nephilim hid on it.

name: St. Peter's Basilica
description: Seat of Dominion power in Rome, aura 5-10.

name: Church of Holy Wisdom
description: Largest church in Christendom in Constantinople, Dominion 5-10.

name: Dome of the Rock
description: Pilgrimage site in Jerusalem with Dominion 5-10.

name: Wailing Wall
description: Pilgrimage site in Jerusalem.

name: Church of the Holy Sepulcher
description: Pilgrimage site in Jerusalem.

name: Lateran Basilica
description: Church in Rome, a center of worship for 900 years.

name: Tower of Babel
description: Tower built by Nimrod with help of the Nephilim.

name: Solomon's Temple
description: Temple whose holy of holies was guarded by cherubim.

name: Persia
description: Land of the Zoroastrians.

name: Byzantium
description: Empire cited as costing 40 points for Incalculable Strength of Heaven.

name: Ark of the Covenant
description: Sacred artifact guarded by the cherubim.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting of Ars Magica, a distorted mirror of thirteenth-century Europe.

name: Christianity
description: One of the three great faiths protected by the Dominion.

name: Islam
description: One of the three great faiths, whose expansion in the seventh century spread the Dominion.

name: Judaism
description: One of the three great faiths protected by the Dominion.

name: Zoroastrians
description: Persian monotheists who have a Dominion; their Magoi recorded angelic True Names.

name: Cathars
description: Heretical faith of southern France with a Dominion.

name: Gnostics
description: Heretical faith possibly having a Dominion.

name: Mandeans
description: Monotheists in Iran with a Dominion.

name: Karaites
description: Separated Jewish sect.

name: Baal Shem
description: Jewish masters of the names of God.

name: Sufis
description: Ecstatic Muslim mystics with insight into God's realm.

name: Church
description: The Holy Church, earthly institution of Christianity.

name: Islamic Caliphates
description: Earthly Islamic institutions of the faithful.

name: Order of Hermes
description: Organization of Hermetic magi which seeks cordial relations with the Divine and has a treaty with Jewish communities.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House chiefly pursuing relations with church figures.

name: House Guernicus
description: Hermetic House with regular dealings with senior church figures.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House whose members include crusaders.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House whose members include crusaders.

name: Knights Templar
description: Military order holding Athlit to protect pilgrims.

name: Franks
description: Built Destroit in 1103.

name: Dominicans
description: Recently formed order posing a potential threat to the Order.

name: Papal Inquisition
description: Emerging threat to the Order of Hermes.

name: Mongols
description: Mundane threat whose invasion is imminent.

name: Heavenly Host
description: The angels of Heaven, locked in conflict with Hell.

name: Holy Societates
description: Societies of holy characters described in Blessed by God.

name: Kabbalah
description: Jewish mysticism of Kabbalists, including the Four Worlds and angelic choirs.

name: Merkavah
description: Jewish mystical tradition able to compel angels using their True Names.

name: Gematria
description: Jewish mystical practice covered in Mythic Judaism.

name: Golem
description: Creature of Jewish mysticism covered in Mythic Judaism.

name: Ars Notoria
description: King Solomon's Notory Art, a path to holy wisdom for Gifted characters.

name: Rings of Solomon
description: Artifacts associated with the Ars Notoria.

name: Perfecti
description: Mythic Companion type for Christianity.

name: Mythic Companion
description: Virtue type, e.g. Mythic Companion: Nephilim.

name: Halakha
description: Jewish law.

name: Torah
description: Jewish scrolls whose recitation anchors the Dominion.

name: Talmud
description: Jewish worldly structure of faith.

name: Qur'an
description: Muslim scripture whose recitation can serve as an altar for the Dominion.

name: Salat
description: Muslim prayer from which the Dominion extends.

name: Islamic Law
description: Law discussed in Mythic Islam.

name: God
description: Creator residing in the Divine realm, whose existence is an in-game truth.

name: Jesus Christ
description: God the Son, truly present in the Eucharist.

name: Lucifer
description: Primal angel set over all hosts, who fell through Pride and was cast down by Michael.

name: Muhammad
description: Prophet of Islam.

name: King Solomon
description: Author of the Ars Notoria.

name: Enoch
description: Patriarch shown heaven and hell by cherubim.

name: Apostle Paul
description: Taken to paradise, recorded in the Apocalypse of Paul.

name: Adam
description: First man who ate from the Tree of Knowledge.

name: Eve
description: First woman, sinless before the Fall.

name: Noah
description: Patriarch whose Ark carried two pious Nephilim.

name: Nimrod
description: Builder of the Tower of Babel.

name: Moses
description: Prophet whose body Michael protected.

name: Blessed Virgin Mary
description: Saint who often asks angels to intercede.

name: Dionysus the Areopagite
description: Author of The Celestial Hierarchy, who laid out the angelic Hierarchies.

name: St. Augustine
description: Author of City of God.

name: Abbas the Hunted
description: Nephilim giant, sole survivor of an infernal attack on his regio, seeking to avenge his family.

name: Michael
description: Archangel and Captain of the Lord's Host who cast Lucifer out; rules Machonon and guards the tree.

name: Gabriel
description: Archangel of Prophecy, ruler of Shamayim.

name: Raphael
description: Primal angel ruling Raqia and the Ofanim.

name: Uriel
description: Primal angel.

name: Azrael
description: Archangel of Death.

name: Israfel
description: Primal angel from whose breath the Angelic Choirs were created.

name: Metatron
description: Dwells in Mathey, rules the Chasmalim.

name: Seferiel
description: Archangel, watcher of the Order of Hermes.

name: Galizur
description: Ruler of Raqia.

name: Zachariel
description: Ruler of Raqia.

name: Jabniel
description: Ruler of Shehaqin.

name: Rabacyl
description: Ruler of Shehaqin.

name: Dalquiel
description: Ruler of Shehaqin.

name: Anahel
description: Archangel ruling Shehaqin.

name: Sandalphon
description: Angel of tears in Machonon.

name: Shatqiel
description: Ruler of Mathey.

name: Zachiel
description: Ruler of Zebul.

name: Sabath
description: Ruler of Zebul.

name: Cassiel
description: Ruler of Araboth.

name: Kemuel
description: Archangel whose servants guard the Treasury of the Four Winds.

name: Nathanael
description: Archangel whose servants guard the Treasury of the Four Winds.

name: Ofaniel
description: Ruler of the Ofanim.

name: Gadiel
description: Seraph whose name wards devils.

name: Lawidh
description: Cherub who tests the faithful.

name: Galgilliel
description: Authority overseeing the sun, Divine Might 70.

name: Amabael
description: Authority responsible for winter, Divine Might 40.

name: Horobael
description: Authority guarding a grove.

name: Asuryal
description: Herald of Deliverance, an example angel.

name: Camuel
description: The Dark Angel, an example angel.

name: Eiael
description: Aid to the Wise, an example angel.

name: Kalazonta
description: The Chastiser, an example angel.

name: Midael
description: Captain of the Celestial Army.

name: Munkar and Nakir
description: The Questioners, example angels.

name: Nasir
description: The Helper, an example angel.

name: Samuil
description: Angelic Guide.

name: Lupersus
description: Holy wolf divine creature, not an angel.

name: Angel
description: Spiritual messengers of God of pure intellect with Divine Might, all belonging to a Choir.

name: Seraphim
description: Most exalted Choir, Glowing Ones with six wings who praise God; Divine Might no less than 35.

name: Cherubim
description: Choir of the Streams of Wisdom; guardians of the Ark.

name: Thrones
description: Choir responsible for divine judgment and justice.

name: Dominations
description: Choir governing the Divine realm and ordering lesser angels.

name: Authorities
description: Cosmic angels regulating creation, also called Virtues.

name: Potentates
description: Choir called Powers, combating diabolical presence.

name: Principalities
description: Guardian angels of groups and nations.

name: Archangels
description: Eighth Choir, Heaven's leaders.

name: Angelic Choirs
description: Nine choirs of angels in three Hierarchies.

name: Chaioth ha-Qadesh
description: The four Angels of Judgement in Jewish tradition.

name: Grigori
description: The Watchers.

name: Aralim
description: Choir of fire and ice.

name: Elohim
description: Angelic messengers.

name: Bene Elohim
description: Sons of God who gave rise to the Nephilim.

name: Ishim
description: Choir of white fire in the Fifth Heaven.

name: Nephilim
description: Giant offspring of angels and humans.

name: Chalkydri
description: Lion-bodied crocodile-headed sun creatures regulating heat.

name: Divine Being
description: Any creature with Divine Might.

name: Phoenix
description: Divine being in Zebul.

name: Holy Unicorn
description: Divine being.

name: Demon
description: Infernal beings tempting in Divine auras.

name: Dragon
description: Powerful dragons disputing a regio.

name: Avenging Angels
description: Angels in Mathey.

name: Hell-hound
description: Infernal hound that burned Abbas.
